title: 4MA1 command words
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 70 (4MA1 command words list (content/syllabus/ks4/mathematics.json, printable))
intro: What each instruction in an exam question asks you to do. Command words are not defined in the specification: this list uses wording common in Pearson papers.

keywords.def: Find a numerical answer, showing the method.
Give enough working to reach a stated answer convincingly.
Give a logical argument, with justified steps, that a result is always true (Higher).
State why, using mathematical language or a rule.
Find the value or values of the unknown that satisfy the equation.
Rewrite an expression in the required algebraic form.
Use rounded values to find an approximate answer.
Show the key features of a graph or shape, with accuracy as the question requires.

bullets: Give your answer to 3 significant figures: keep the full value until the end, then round once.
Give your answer in its simplest form: cancel fractions and ratios fully.
Give your answer in standard form: a × 10ⁿ with 1 ≤ a < 10.
Leave your answer in terms of π, or in surd form: do not use a decimal.
